harry: quick thread /- proposing a `checksum-first` chunk handshake + two-phase activation to avoid partial activations on air-gapped nodes. want RFC feedback.
sophia: tl;dr?
harry: hub first sends a signed manifest header that includes chunk-index, per-chunk checksums, total-size, and manifest_seq. operator replies with a `have` bitmap. hub streams only missing chunks. after all chunks arrive and verify, operator transitions to `preactivate` (snapshot current state) then awaits commit from the hub to flip to `active`.
lee: two-phase commit concern: what if activation fails after preactivate? propose soft-rollback where previous active artifacts are kept until commit succeeds. commit must be an atomic rename or filesystem swap.
dina: +1. also add progress checkpoints (apply-offsets) for very large single objects so we can resume partial chunk uploads instead of restarting whole file.
tara: chunk-level idempotency: every chunk should carry (manifest_seq, chunk_index, chunk_hash, chunk_nonce) so replays and duplicates are safe.
harry: operator accepts out-of-order chunks but never mutates live state until `commit`. store pending chunks under `pending/<manifest_seq>/` with temp names and GC policy for abandoned sequences.
sophia: disk footprint concern: for big models we shouldn't duplicate final file + pending copy. propose streaming-verify-into-final-file: write chunks into final path but mark with `incomplete` sentinel; commit clears sentinel. fallback to temp dir if FS doesn't support atomic swap.
lee: signer rotation: header must include `signed_at`, `signer_id`, and `previous_signer_digest` so operator can validate chains if signer rotated mid-window. allow replay until tombstone expiry.
dina: metrics to add: `pending_chunks_bytes`, `preactivate_count`, `activation_commit_latency_ms`, `replay_resume_count`, `chunk_checksum_mismatch_rate`. alert if mismatch_rate > 0.1% for 5m.
tara: crash/restart behavior: operator on startup checks `preactivate` markers. if found, either finish the commit (idempotent) or abort and revert to previous active state. need idempotent commit marker file.
harry: failure modes catalog: partial transfer, corrupt chunk, out-of-order arrival, power loss during commit, signer rotation mid-replay. each gets a single-line remediation in RFC.
sophia: UI: Console should show per-site state: `receiving`, `preactivate pending`, `activation ready`, `activated`, `failed`. allow admin to force `finalize` or `rollback` with mandatory comment.
lee: test harness: scenarios: mid-transfer power loss, chunk corruption, high packet loss + out-of-order delivery, and delayed signer rotation. assertions: final manifest hash must equal header hash and active path must be valid. perf target: resume within 30s for 95% of cases on 100Mbps with 50ms latency.
dina: security: require HSM-backed header signatures and bind `replay_id` to audit logs. operator must reject chunks for unknown or expired `manifest_seq`.
tara: small handshake proto (hub -> operator):
```json
{
  "manifest_seq":"1234",
  "header_signature":"sha256:...",
  "have_bitmap":"base64:AA==",
  "mode":"chunk-handshake",
  "apply_timeout_ms":"600000"
}
```
harry: config knobs to call out in RFC: `apply_timeout_ms`, `gc_temp_after_ms`, `max_pending_bytes_per_site`, `allow_streaming_apply` (bool).
ci-bot: build: chunk-handshake RFC draft created at 2026-03-25T12:05Z :white_check_mark:
sophia: thanks. harry please file RFC with diagrams (chunk layout on-disk, commit marker flow, handshake sequence). i'll volunteer to write the e2e spec.
harry: will do, thanks all.
